text.zh-CN: Palantir 2026 年第二季度收入为 19.35464 亿美元，同比增长 93%；美国商业收入为 7.64 亿美元，同比增长 149%。
text.en: Palantir reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.935464 billion, up 93% year over year, with U.S. commercial revenue of $764 million, up 149%.

text.zh-CN: 美国商业 TCV bookings 为 21.32 亿美元，同比增长 153%；公司将 2026 年收入指引上调至 81.50–81.58 亿美元。
text.en: U.S. commercial TCV bookings reached $2.132 billion, up 153%, while FY2026 revenue guidance rose to $8.150–8.158 billion.

text.zh-CN: 美国商业收入已相当于美国政府收入的约 94%，商业预算正在成为第二条规模化增长曲线。
text.en: U.S. commercial revenue reached roughly 94% of U.S. government revenue, making commercial budgets a second growth engine at scale.

text.zh-CN: 若 bookings、TCV 与确认收入继续同步，企业客户可能已把 AIP 从试验预算迁入核心经营预算，足以延长高增长久期。
text.en: If bookings, TCV and recognized revenue remain aligned, enterprise customers may be moving AIP from pilot spend into core operating budgets, extending the duration of elevated growth.

text.zh-CN: 合同指标若先于收入明显减速，预算迁移命题会弱化，高 forward-sales 定价的容错空间也会迅速收窄。
text.en: A material slowdown in contract indicators ahead of revenue would weaken the budget-migration thesis and sharply reduce the tolerance embedded in a high forward-sales valuation.

zh-CN.whyItMatters: 上游 AI 支出已经容易观察，应用层能否持续拿到企业核心预算仍是稀缺证据。PLTR 提供了清晰样本，也把估值风险推到研究中心。

text.zh-CN: Cloudflare Q2 2026 收入为 6.961 亿美元，同比增长 36%；current RPO 同比增长 35%。
text.en: Cloudflare reported Q2 2026 revenue of $696.1 million, up 36%, with current RPO also up 35%.

text.zh-CN: 截至 2026 年 6 月，年化收入超过 10 万美元的大客户为 4,698 家；Q2 自由现金流为 5,640 万美元，利润率 8%。
text.en: Cloudflare ended June with 4,698 customers above $100,000 in annualized revenue and generated $56.4 million of Q2 free cash flow, an 8% margin.

text.zh-CN: 公司 Investor Day 披露，2025-06-01 至 2026-05-31，Cloudflare 网络上的日均 AI agent 请求量增长超过 1,700%。
text.en: At Investor Day, Cloudflare disclosed more than 1,700% growth in daily AI-agent requests on its network from June 1, 2025 through May 31, 2026.

text.zh-CN: NET 的核心变量是 monetization density：一次 agent 动作穿过 Workers、网络、安全和身份等收费层的数量，比请求量本身更接近收入价值。
text.en: NET's key variable is monetization density: the number of paid Workers, network, security and identity layers touched by an agent action should matter more than raw request growth.

text.zh-CN: 若 agent 请求继续高速增长，而收入、current RPO 和自由现金流率没有同步改善，流量可能主要停留在低价或未收费层。
text.en: If agent requests keep compounding without corresponding gains in revenue, current RPO and free-cash-flow margin, much of the traffic may remain in low-priced or unmetered layers.

zh-CN.standfirst: 1,700% 的请求增速证明流量存在，尚未证明单位机器活动更值钱。研究重点应落在收费层密度。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: Agent 会制造远高于人类访问的调用频次。Cloudflare 若能在同一动作上叠加执行、安全、身份与网络收费，收入可以慢于流量却快于客户数。
zh-CN.consensus: 市场看到了 36% 收入增长、35% current RPO 增长和 1,700% 的 AI agent 请求增速。
zh-CN.differentiated: 要跟踪请求穿过多少收费产品，以及这些产品是否拉动合同余额和自由现金流率。
zh-CN.valuation: 估值用 Q2 年化收入构建企业价值情景。它是敏感性分析，不是公司指引或目标价。

en.title: Cloudflare: Monetization density is the bridge from agent traffic to revenue
en.question: Can machine-request growth cross more paid layers and show up in contracts and cash flow?
en.standfirst: A 1,700% increase establishes that the traffic exists. It says nothing yet about revenue per machine action. The underwriting variable is monetization density.
en.whyItMatters: Agents can generate far more calls than human browsing. If Cloudflare attaches compute, security, identity and network charges to the same action, revenue can outgrow customers even while trailing raw traffic.
en.consensus: The visible numbers are 36% revenue growth, 35% current-RPO growth and 1,700% growth in AI-agent requests.
en.differentiated: Track how many paid products each action touches and whether that attach rate lifts contracted backlog and free-cash-flow margin.
en.valuation: The scenarios annualize Q2 revenue and apply explicit growth and multiple assumptions. They are sensitivity cases, not guidance or target prices.
en.update: The first canonical company edition preserves the August 7 information set and removes the unverified option-premium estimate from the fact layer.

text.zh-CN: Atlassian FY2026 Q4 收入为 17.66469 亿美元，同比增长约 28%；全年收入为 65.72308 亿美元，同比增长 26%。
text.en: Atlassian reported FY2026 Q4 revenue of $1.766469 billion, up roughly 28%, and full-year revenue of $6.572308 billion, up 26%.

text.zh-CN: 截至 2026-06-30，Subscription ARR 为 66.06 亿美元，同比增长 23%。
text.en: Subscription ARR reached $6.606 billion at June 30, 2026, up 23%.

text.zh-CN: Atlassian 在 SEC 披露中把产品组合描述为互联应用、AI agents 与 Collections，并称其共享 Cloud Platform 与数据模型。
text.en: In its SEC disclosure, Atlassian describes a portfolio of connected apps, AI agents and Collections built on a shared Cloud Platform and data model.

text.zh-CN: AI coding 可能减少部分人类席位，同时制造更多任务、评审、依赖和治理对象；TEAM 的增长函数可能从 seat 数扩展到 workflow density 与组织上下文。
text.en: AI coding may reduce some human seats while creating more tasks, reviews, dependencies and governance objects, expanding TEAM's growth function from seat count toward workflow density and organizational context.

text.zh-CN: 若 Subscription ARR 持续低于收入增长，且公司不披露 agent 活动或上下文收费指标，seat compression 可能快于新计费单位形成。
text.en: If subscription ARR continues to lag revenue growth and Atlassian does not disclose agent-activity or context-monetization metrics, seat compression may be arriving faster than a new billing unit.

zh-CN.title: Atlassian：workflow density 能否成为新的收费基础
zh-CN.question: AI 减少人类 seat 后，组织上下文和协同对象能否补上收入？
zh-CN.standfirst: TEAM 已有共享数据模型与跨产品工作流。接下来要看的，是 agent 是否制造可收费的任务、依赖和治理，而不只是带来更多 AI 使用。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: 传统协作软件按人头收费。AI coding 让席位承压，却也增加机器生成的工作状态。能否把这些状态变成新计费单位，决定 TEAM 的增长制度。
zh-CN.consensus: FY2026 收入增长 26%，Subscription ARR 增长 23%，产品组合正围绕共享平台和 AI agents 重构。

zh-CN.update: 首版对象保留 2026-08-07 信息集。原报告的 squeeze 贡献和 Rovo 2x 相关性不再作为已核验事实。

en.title: Atlassian: Can workflow density become a new billing base?
en.question: If AI reduces human seats, can organizational context and coordination objects replace the lost economics?
en.standfirst: TEAM already owns a shared data model and cross-product workflows. The next test is whether agents create billable tasks, dependencies and governance—not merely more AI usage.
en.whyItMatters: Collaboration software has historically monetized headcount. AI coding pressures seats while generating machine-created work state. TEAM's next growth regime depends on turning that state into a billing unit.
en.consensus: FY2026 revenue grew 26%, subscription ARR grew 23%, and the portfolio is being rebuilt around a shared platform and AI agents.
en.differentiated: The revenue function could broaden from human seats to workflow density, agent activity and organizational context. Management has not yet supplied enough disaggregated metrics to prove it.
en.valuation: The scenarios start with FY2026 revenue and test context monetization against seat compression. Outputs are enterprise-value sensitivities only.
en.update: This first canonical edition preserves the August 7 information set. The original squeeze attribution and Rovo 2x correlation are no longer treated as verified facts.

text.zh-CN: PLTR、NET 与 TEAM 分别提供商业预算、机器流量收费层和组织上下文三种价值捕获路径。
text.en: PLTR, NET and TEAM expose three distinct capture paths: commercial budgets, paid machine-traffic layers and organizational context.

text.zh-CN: 控制组中，DDOG Q2 2026 收入为 11.21454 亿美元，同比增长 36%，自由现金流为 2.79 亿美元。
text.en: In the control group, DDOG reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.121454 billion, up 36%, and free cash flow of $279 million.

text.zh-CN: 另一控制组 APP Q2 2026 收入为 19.24 亿美元，同比增长 53%，调整后 EBITDA 为 16.14 亿美元。
text.en: The second control, APP, reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.924 billion, up 53%, and adjusted EBITDA of $1.614 billion.

text.zh-CN: AI usage 只有穿过可识别的收费单位，并在收入、合同余额或现金流中留下痕迹，才构成可持续 value capture。
text.en: AI usage becomes durable value capture only when it crosses an identifiable billing unit and leaves evidence in revenue, contracted backlog or cash flow.

text.zh-CN: DDOG 与 APP 说明 AI 相关增长可以伴随较强现金转化；若核心组只报告 adoption 或流量，却不能接近控制组的财务传导，主题判断应降级。
text.en: DDOG and APP show that AI-related growth can coexist with strong cash conversion. If the core cohort reports adoption or traffic without comparable financial transmission, the theme should be downgraded.

zh-CN.title: AI usage 到 value capture：五家公司横截面检验
zh-CN.question: 使用量增长何时能成为可持续收入、合同与现金流？
zh-CN.standfirst: PLTR、NET、TEAM 给出三条收费路径，DDOG 与 APP 提供财务控制组。主题成立需要多家公司把使用量变成可核验的财务传导。
zh-CN.whyItMatters: AI adoption 指标很容易增长，收费单位更难建立。横截面比较可以把公司特有的爆发与真正的产业扩散分开。
zh-CN.consensus: 市场已经接受 AI 使用量快速增长，也看到了多家公司收入提速。
zh-CN.differentiated: 研究单位应从 adoption 切到预算、收费层、workflow objects 和现金转化，并要求核心组接近控制组的财务质量。
zh-CN.valuation: 主题估值使用标准化收入指数，只比较增长和倍数制度，不合成市值，也不给目标价。
zh-CN.update: v2.0 保留 2026-08-07 时点，把原 NET+TEAM 页面升级为含两个控制组的 Theme Study。

causalChain.title: Usage 进入业务流程
causalChain.body: 预算、机器调用和工作对象是三种可观察入口。

causalChain.title: 收费单位形成
causalChain.body: 企业需要为决策、执行层或组织上下文付费。

causalChain.title: 财务报表验收
causalChain.body: 收入、合同余额和现金转化决定价值是否真正被捕获。

en.title: From AI usage to value capture: A five-company cross-sectional test
en.question: When does usage growth become durable revenue, contracted backlog and cash flow?
en.standfirst: PLTR, NET and TEAM offer three billing paths; DDOG and APP provide financial controls. The theme requires multiple companies to turn usage into observable financial transmission.
en.whyItMatters: AI adoption metrics can rise almost by construction. Billing units are harder. A cross-sectional frame separates company-specific breakouts from genuine industry diffusion.
en.consensus: Investors already accept rapid AI-usage growth and have seen revenue acceleration across several companies.
en.differentiated: Move the unit of analysis from adoption to budgets, paid layers, workflow objects and cash conversion, then hold the core cohort against the financial quality of the controls.
en.valuation: Theme valuation uses a normalized revenue index to compare growth and multiple regimes. It neither aggregates market values nor produces target prices.
en.update: Version 2.0 preserves the August 7 information set and upgrades the original NET+TEAM page into a Theme Study with two controls.

causalChain.title: Usage enters production
causalChain.body: Budgets, machine calls and work objects provide three observable entry points.

causalChain.title: A billing unit forms
causalChain.body: Customers pay for decisions, execution layers or organizational context.

causalChain.title: Financials settle capture
causalChain.body: Revenue, backlog and cash conversion determine whether value was actually captured.

dataGaps.zh-CN: 五家公司没有统一口径的 AI 收入披露，因此主题研究使用各自最接近价值捕获的财务指标。
dataGaps.en: The five companies do not disclose AI revenue on a common basis, so the study uses the closest company-specific financial proxy for capture.

dataGaps.zh-CN: DDOG 与 APP 是机制控制组，不是业务模式或估值可比公司。
dataGaps.en: DDOG and APP are mechanism controls, not direct business-model or valuation comparables.
